name: sichtbar
style: cinematic movie trailer score, dark and quiet opening with low drone and single felt piano notes, subtle Mediterranean nylon guitar, gradual build with warm strings and soft taiko pulses, rising to a warm golden orchestral swell, final resonant hit and gentle tail for the logo, no vocals, 80 bpm
